units.source_text: 一条宽阔而迂回的路——刚觉登上去旋即又下坡的迂回的路环绕着公园，

en.t: A broad, winding path, one that seemed no sooner to climb than it immediately sloped downward again, encircled the park,

units.source_text: 到处都是树墩子、灌木和小松，还有一块巨大的白岩石，

en.t: and everywhere there were tree stumps, shrubs, and small pines, as well as a huge white rock,

units.source_text: 一半理在地下，四周竞相怒放着紫红杜鹃花。

en.t: half buried in the ground, with purplish-red azaleas blooming fiercely all around it as if competing with one another.

units.source_text: 这颜色在阴沉的天空映衬下，似是带有几分的恶意。

en.t: Against the gloomy sky, that color seemed to carry a certain trace of malice.
